hypothesis: For VTBR only, sustained weekly direction or weekly closes beyond SMA20 may remove false Band-ZigZag reversal entries; compare separately for long and short without changing the exit rule.

research_provenance.source: User supplied Trendoscope Band-ZigZag Pine and weekly chart 2026-11-07
research_provenance.note: Imported eta.bb sticky/adaptive internals are unavailable. This experiment explicitly uses standard SMA20 Bollinger bands, population standard deviation and multiplier 2, without sticky/adaptive; it is not an exact test of the original visual script.

parameter_rationale: 2–4 completed weekly closes compare current two-close rule to a month of persistence. SMA20 checks sustained location; combined requires both. All signals use completed weeks and next-week opening fill.
baseline: Same-stock 25%-capital buy-and-hold on the same weekly bars and costs.
signal_rule: Band events and pivots match parent. After a low/high pivot, within 8 weeks enter long/short after 2–4 completed directional weekly closes, 2–4 closes above/below rolling SMA20, or both. At most once per pivot. Opposite entry reverses at next weekly open.
signal_semantics: Causal weekly Band-ZigZag inspired pivot and post-pivot turn; source-library sticky/adaptive behavior deliberately excluded.
evaluation_unit: Independent 1m RUB virtual account per symbol; this is not a combined portfolio.
execution_timing: Observe completed 1W candle; order at next available 1W open. No orders at visually backdated pivot center.
holding_period: Until opposite signal or next-open execution after weekly target observation.
rebalance_rule: No intrabar rebalance; at most one position per account.
availability_lag: A weekly pivot exists at close of its band-touch week; a turn needs at least one subsequent completed week.
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: VTBR diagnostic only; directional_2 is exact current rule. Compare early 2024–2025 and already-seen 2026, annual and monthly PnL, long/short separately. No paper promotion from one ticker.
limitations: Single VTBR ticker, not broad validation
